notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Time for a long-overdue update on what I’ve been working on since the last patch.

Right now, I’m focused on finishing the "second part" of the game (which should conclude with the ritual with the succubus). This requires a good number of new cutscenes and assets. There won’t be much gameplay in the next patch —it will be more about story development and narrative content.



Here are the changes so far:

Herbs have finally made it into the game — the ones mentioned in the quest. You won’t need to collect them like you did with the stones; Evi will find them herself when the corresponding cutscenes are triggered.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/4d2ac9d4c7513aadf7bc0d18293d7fbd06674d43.png"]

I’ve reworked the Mimic's model for Evi’s second encounter with it. The overall design is mostly the same, but I needed a more flexible model and a rig that’s easier to work with. For now, these changes won’t affect the first scene, but I plan to eventually remake it using the new model.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/f412d258000087277e94208192284d9aafe184a4.png"]

I’ve also made a couple of animations for the new encounter with the Mimic.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/03aec15c42a0019e2bf2932519e25b1b24b47d7b.png"]

Since the ritual preparation involves alchemy, I designed a mini-puzzle themed around it. Its concept is fairly abstract — you won’t be pouring liquids into test tubes or anything like that, but it still ties into the idea of alchemy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/94a0bdcbdf42108552a7244f6cf489515115fef9.png"]



There’s still quite a bit of work ahead, and unfortunately, I won’t be able to release this in smaller chunks — for a story-focused update like this, I’d like to keep everything cohesive.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.1 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed disappearing parts of the character in one of the cutscenes.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.1
notes.notes:
Hint system moved to Special Abilities. While active, Concentration mode highlights interactable objects, but slows down character movement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/dd76414b5ab871f90e760fe642497fcafa03a764.png
 As an experiment I changed tech behind cum stains. Now it’s texture overlay instead of mesh and stains have stages of buildup (three stages for every hole)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/8b04bc53c4ac882b50e04fc7a4842ddf9c9fef05.gif
 Added missing climax animations for Succubus.
 Made some corrections and adjustments to constraints in Physics Assets of characters. Added jiggle physics in the thigh/butt area for Evi and Succubus.
 Marked ‘north’ on the drawing to help with orientation while solving the last puzzle.
 Bugfixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.10 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Seems like there’s a lot of frustration happening in relation to the beam puzzle. Forcing people to spend their entire evenings rolling for dexterity wasn't part of my plan, so I made a couple of adjustments.


 Targets move ~20% slower
 Beam now ~20% wider
 Statue rotates ~50% faster with less lag and takes into account look sensitivity settings

notes.title: Patch 0.10
notes.notes:
The door with ‘in development’ sign (in the hall before priestess encounter) can now be opened and it leads to a new puzzle room. Even though this puzzle is less cryptic, as an experiment I added an intermediate autosave between two logical parts. I think this approach could serve as a compromise between complete reset and saving every action.
Since I had to adapt this puzzle for the controller, I wonder if I made it too easy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/5a7ddc11de576116d65ba6b9d850759cd19839b2.png
 Added H scene with succubus

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/c79da27cd6797030db085af5ad71e1fab8d6a23c.png
 After mimic scene added popup that tells player about Research Diary
 ‘E’ hint should properly remove itself after picking up figurines

notes.title: Patch 0.09.3
notes.notes:
Redone one of the animations with male summon on the table
 All animations with male summon now have climax option
 Added voice samples for new animations
 Fixed several bugs

Originally I planned to add missing climax animations for succubus as well, but making this batch already took too long. I need to start working on the next puzzle and after that I’ll probably deal with animations for succubus.

notes.title: Patch 0.09.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed crash that occurred in one of the cutscenes if Evi was wearing purple outfit.
 Enabled controller input while inspecting objects.

notes.title: Patch 0.09.2
notes.notes:
Added minimap. Minimap is designed to be very basic, to show discovered level sections, portals and save points. No quest markers or anything of that kind is planned. To see minimap hold Spacebar or Left Trigger, to zoom in/out use Mouse Wheel or Shoulder Buttons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44951135/b5403e04d4ad3fba2a7fa79c45ab17c1487fbe51.png
 Added new voice samples for Evi in H scenes, there's a lot more variety now and less repetition. As for the summons, they will have to silently wait for later patches.
 Added localized version of intro (subtitles only)
 Visibility of the text box in cutscenes can now be toggled via Tab key.
 Improved shader and models for ice cubes.
 Bugfixes


There were reports regarding issues with launching game on Steam Deck. I made a post in discussions, that should help with the problem: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2878000/discussions/0/4625854789815677939/

notes.title: Patch 0.09.1
notes.notes:
Project moved to UE 5.4. With that I also had to make internal changes in the input system, which means that custom control settings will be reset. Other than that everything should function as before.
Now you can use the gamepad to control character by default. However for UI navigation you still have to use cursor. It's ugly, yes, but adaptation of the game to the controller is an extensive task and this is the first step. You can change some key bindings in settings (look sensitivity also affects gamepad)
 Added Evi POV in H scenes
 Orbit camera now saves its last position before going POV so that it doesn't appear in weird places on switching back from POV to Orbit
 After climax stains persist (while in scene viewer), there's Clean button now to remove them manually
 Closed with geometry necks of summons when switching to POV
 Added several hints in form of text in places where people get stuck the most
 Black outfit now available in all replays
 For replay of the last event I added options to watch only H scenes for both forms
 Added research diary in succubus room so that players won't have to run back to the main hub
 Added a small vfx around the character's head that signals when interactables become highlighted


There are still probably some issues that I missed caused by upgrading engine version. If you notice something doesn't function properly, please report.

notes.title: Update 0.09
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. In this update I added a new puzzle room. This puzzle room is part of an event where Evi with the help of several new characters learns a new cosmetic ability. To access it you will need a key that can be found in the last room of the planet puzzle. After you pick up the key, you will be able to open a previously inactive door in the hall with an area for summoning. 
New H content includes one collectable scene and three event scenes. Event scenes can be replayed via Research Diary in the main hub.
Also:

 Added optional slight camera shake in H scenes. 
 Added floor collision for camera.
 When switching poses the camera doesn’t jump anymore.
 Voice volume slider now works properly.
 Fixed an issue with overlapping UI elements on lower resolutions (hopefully)
 Other bug fixes.

Some of the requested features I had to postpone in order not to delay the release. Please report any bugs.

notes.title: Patch 0.08.1
notes.notes:
Added ability to edit key mappings (as of now, the system is not comprehensive,  but allows to remap things important for gameplay)
 Removed collision from the device in the center of planet puzzle, should make orb insertion easier.
 Edited a few lines in the dialogs to hopefully give clearer guidance.
 Added wardrobe mirror in the succubus room.
 Now when switching outfits or animations, interface shows total number of options available in the game, marked by '?' If you have yet to find them.
 Exposed more options in graphics settings. For those who have fps issues, I'd recommend changing Anti Aliasing method to TAA.
 Added Russian localization.
 In the main hub added Research Diary (a book lying on one of the tables). It allows to replay key scenes (currently two).
 Added toggle for camera auto rotation (R) in scene viewer, there's also speed and direction for it.
 Reduced backtracking. Now some of the cutscenes play back to back without need to manually trigger them. If you saved game somewhere in between, saves should still work.
 Added little bit of physics for ears and hair.
 Bugfixes.
